attempts.text:
Only Trishuli shelter counts as an evacuation point. Dupcheshwar temple is not designated, so people dropped there would not count as rescued. The Trishuli–Naukunda road is closed, so all routes go through Gosaikunda temple.

**Options compared**
- **Naukunda farm (4 adults):** a round trip via Gosaikunda is 23 + 23 = 46 minutes. Deferring them would cost 80, so rescuing saves 34.
- **Dupcheshwar temple (4 adults):** a round trip via Gosaikunda is 36 + 36 = 72 minutes. Deferring would cost 80, so rescuing saves 8.
- **Bidur village (2 shopkeepers, treated as adults):** the cheapest route is via Dupcheshwar, 58 minutes each way, so 116 minutes for the round trip. Deferring costs only 40, so deferring is cheaper.
- **Picking up the shopkeepers with the Dupcheshwar group:** the car holds only four people, so two Dupcheshwar labourers would need a separate trip. This costs more.

<plan>
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple naukunda-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-farm gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple dupcheshwar-temple
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer bidur-village adult 2
</plan>

The total is 46 + 72 = 118 driving minutes, plus a 40-point penalty for the two deferred shopkeepers.

COST: 158
